name: The natural world
description: A closer look at living things and the remarkable world around us.

questions.answer: A community of organisms and the nonliving environment they interact with.
questions.explanation: A pond ecosystem includes its fish, plants and microbes, plus the water, sunlight and mud they depend on.

image.alt: A simple diagram of a leaf and its branching veins

questions.answer: A process in which inherited traits that improve reproductive success become more common over generations.
questions.explanation: Charles Darwin and Alfred Russel Wallace first presented the idea together in 1858.

questions.answer: The transfer of pollen from a flower's anther to a stigma, often by wind or by animals such as bees.
questions.explanation: Pollination lets many flowering plants make seeds.

questions.answer: A long, deep rest in which an animal's body temperature, heart rate and metabolism drop sharply to save energy through winter.
questions.explanation: Ground squirrels, many bats and marmots are true hibernators.
